items.label: Drinking water: 3-4 litres per person per day (minimum 3-day supply)
Non-perishable ready-to-eat dry rations (biscuits, dates, nuts, flattened rice/aval)
Water purification tablets (Chlorine/Halazone) or portable filter
Infant formula / baby food if children present
First aid box (sterile gauze, bandage, antiseptic Dettol/Betadine, burn cream)
Critical 7-14 day supply of personal prescription medications (BP, diabetes, asthma, thyroid)
Oral Rehydration Salts (ORS) packets
Paracetamol, antihistamines, and anti-diarrheal tablets
Sanitary pads, hand sanitizer, and soap
High-intensity LED torch + 2 extra sets of dry batteries
Loud safety whistle to signal rescue teams through darkness/water
Multi-tool or sturdy pocket knife + pair of scissors
15-20 meters of 10mm nylon climbing/safety rope
Thick leather or rubber work gloves (for debris and electrical insulation)
Waterproof matches or lighter sealed in a plastic pouch
Waterproof zipper pouch containing Aadhaar, Voter ID, Land deeds, Bank passbooks, Ration card
Emergency cash in small denominations (ATMs and UPI fail during power outages)
Laminated card with handwritten phone numbers of family, DEOC (1077), and local ward councillor
Fully charged 20,000 mAh power bank with compatible charging cables
Battery-operated portable AM/FM radio (for All India Radio disaster bulletins)
Basic spare feature/keypad phone (longer battery life than smartphones)
Raincoat, waterproof ponchos, or heavy plastic tarpaulin sheet
Fleece blankets or space/thermal emergency foil blanket
Sturdy closed shoes / gumboots to protect against debris, glass, and snakes
2 pairs of dry clothes sealed in waterproof bags

hazard_specific_notes.flood: Prioritize high-elevation storage, floating dry-bags, chlorine tablets, and rubber gumboots to prevent leptospirosis (rat fever).
hazard_specific_notes.earthquake: Prioritize sturdy hard hats or helmets, thick leather gloves, whistle for signaling beneath rubble, and dust masks (N95).
hazard_specific_notes.landslide: Prioritize compact lightweight backpack with quick grab-handles, headlights/hands-free torches, and durable hiking footwear.
